exposure: maternal serum placental growth factor (PlGF) level
cohort: Pregnant individuals at risk, involving small-for-gestational-age (SGA) fetuses, intrauterine fetal growth restriction (IUGR), gestational hypertension (GH), or preeclampsia (PE).
finding: UA Doppler PI and maternal serum PlGF determinations in the third trimester help identify pregnancies at high risk of adverse perinatal outcomes due to IUGR and/or PE, with UA Doppler PI alone being as effective as combined testing.
